Fits the models behind Table 2 and eTables 1 to 3. The paper's models were fit in Stata; these are rebuilt from its text and table footnotes ([#D6]).

::: {.Rcode title="Source code"}
The full R script is available at:

-   [`R/models.R`](https://github.com/VagishHemmige/Dialysis-facility-density-USRDS/blob/main/R/models.R)

This R script file is itself reliant on the following files:

-   [`R/setup.R`](https://github.com/VagishHemmige/Dialysis-facility-density-USRDS/blob/main/R/setup.R)
-   [`R/functions.R`](https://github.com/VagishHemmige/Dialysis-facility-density-USRDS/blob/main/R/functions.R)
-   [`R/define_exposure.R`](https://github.com/VagishHemmige/Dialysis-facility-density-USRDS/blob/main/R/define_exposure.R)

The code sections below are imported directly from that script when this page is rendered.
:::

```{r}
#| include: false
#| eval: true
#| cache: false
knitr::read_chunk("../R/models.R")
```

## Table 2

Mixed-effects logistic models with a random intercept for HSA [@lme4_pkg], progressively adjusted. Models 2 and 3 are fit with and without albumin and hemoglobin; with them, patients missing either value drop out, as in the paper's complete-case models.

## Multiple imputation

The original R code has no imputation: the paper's multiple imputation sensitivity analysis (eTable 2) was done in Stata, and the paper gives only "chained equations, 10 imputations". This rebuilds it with `mice` to show how the analysis is replicated; it is provisional and not expected to match exactly ([#D7]).

